configs.title: Leakage-safe scikit-learn pipeline
configs.note: Preprocessing inside the CV loop so the validation fold never leaks.
configs.code:
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline
from sklearn.preprocessing import OneHotEncoder, StandardScaler
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold, cross_val_score

pre = ColumnTransformer([
    ("num", StandardScaler(), num_cols),
    ("cat", OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown="ignore"), cat_cols),
])
model = Pipeline([("pre", pre), ("clf", HistGradientBoostingClassifier())])
cv = StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=0)
scores = cross_val_score(model, X, y, cv=cv, scoring="average_precision")
print(scores.mean(), scores.std())

configs.title: Training loop essentials (bf16, grad accumulation, clipping)
configs.note: The five lines that prevent most training bugs.
configs.code:
import torch
opt = torch.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=3e-4, betas=(0.9, 0.95), weight_decay=0.1)
sched = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.OneCycleLR(opt, max_lr=3e-4, total_steps=total_steps, pct_start=0.05)
accum = 8
for step, (x, y) in enumerate(loader):
    with torch.autocast("cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16):
        loss = model(x.cuda(), y.cuda()) / accum
    loss.backward()
    if (step + 1) % accum == 0:
        torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), 1.0)
        opt.step(); sched.step(); opt.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)

configs.title: Messages API: system prompt cache + streaming + tool
configs.note: Static content first and marked cacheable; dynamic content last.
configs.code:
import anthropic
client = anthropic.Anthropic()

with client.messages.stream(
    model="claude-sonnet-5-5",
    max_tokens=1024,
    system=[{"type": "text", "text": LONG_STATIC_INSTRUCTIONS,
             "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}}],
    tools=[{"name": "get_order", "description": "Look up an order by id",
            "input_schema": {"type": "object",
                             "properties": {"order_id": {"type": "string"}},
                             "required": ["order_id"]}}],
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": user_text}],
) as stream:
    for text in stream.text_stream:
        print(text, end="", flush=True)
    final = stream.get_final_message()
print(final.usage)

configs.title: OpenTelemetry OTLP tracing setup
configs.note: Send spans to Langfuse, Phoenix, Tempo or any OTLP backend.
configs.code:
from opentelemetry import trace
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace import TracerProvider
from opentelemetry.sdk.trace.export import BatchSpanProcessor
from opentelemetry.exporter.otlp.proto.http.trace_exporter import OTLPSpanExporter

provider = TracerProvider()
provider.add_span_processor(BatchSpanProcessor(OTLPSpanExporter(endpoint="http://localhost:4318/v1/traces")))
trace.set_tracer_provider(provider)
tracer = trace.get_tracer("agent")

with tracer.start_as_current_span("llm.call") as span:
    span.set_attribute("gen_ai.request.model", model)
    r = call_llm(...)
    span.set_attribute("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens", r.usage.input_tokens)
    span.set_attribute("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens", r.usage.output_tokens)
